title: Legacy Input and Output APIs knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Legacy Input and Output APIs”?
options: Legacy Input and Output APIs should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
Legacy Input and Output APIs helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
Legacy Input and Output APIs means the browser can enforce all permissions without the backend.
Legacy Input and Output APIs removes the need for error handling, accessibility checks and tests.
questions.answer_key: Legacy Input and Output APIs helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: Legacy Input and Output APIs is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.prompt: How should a learner work with “@Input” in this lesson?
options: Connect “@Input” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
Treat “@Input” as a reason to skip the surrounding application context.
Assume “@Input” works identically across every Angular major and runtime.
Use “@Input” to bypass runtime validation of external or user-provided values.
questions.answer_key: Connect “@Input” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “@Input” under Legacy Input and Output APIs. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Legacy Input and Output APIs”?
options: Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.answer_key: Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
